blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: It is hard to win four successive games.
exercises.why: **последовательных** — после́довательный: consistent, logical; successive; step-by-step; sequential. Wiktionary: после́довать + -тельный.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: We inherit our genes from our parents.
exercises.why: **наследуем** — насле́довать (imperfective and perfective): (also, figurative) to inherit (property, traditions, vices, etc.); (perfective only) to receive an inheritance; (imperfective only) to have the right to receive an inheritance.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: without a trace, tracelessly, completely, utterly (of a disappearance)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: воспосле́довать — (archaic) to follow; после́довательность — consistency, logicality; после́довательный — consistent, logical; бессле́дно — without a trace, tracelessly, completely, utterly (of a disappearance).

**наследует** — насле́довать (imperfective and perfective): (also, figurative) to inherit (property, traditions, vices, etc.); (perfective only) to receive an inheritance; (imperfective only) to have the right to receive an inheritance.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?
